name: CliffRock
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.488

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven rock_face_03 with its two straight through-going joints located and covered by a turned, enlarged copy of itself, plus patches of Poly Haven rock_face at a non-commensurate scale; large-scale brightness drift removed; graded to the dark grey-brown of the original cliffs
known_weaknesses: no bedding direction, so it does not read as layered strata; relief of 8 cm needs parallax or tessellation to show on a flat cliff mesh
